• Citizen Web Application: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite. Native W3C Web Speech API with 2.2s silence debounce and internal Bengali-to-English medical translation engine.
• Clinical Triage Engine: Sub-millisecond rule-based classifier implementing Emergency Severity Index (ESI-1 to ESI-5). Zero LLM network dependency in critical resuscitation path.
• Geospatial & Road Routing: Leaflet.js + OpenStreetMap, PostGIS spatial indexing, self-hosted OSRM engine delivering sub-second road distances (<420ms) with urban traffic calibration.
• Real-Time Cloud Synchronization: Supabase WebSockets + PostgreSQL atomic row-level locks (SELECT FOR UPDATE) for race-condition-free bed reservation and instant hospital updates.
• Hospital Admin Command Desk: Tablet/desktop web portal with high-contrast ward tiles, audio klaxons, 1-tap bed/nurse counters, and 6-digit OTP entrance verification terminal.
